## Research status

**Technical owners.** 4 canonical routes.

**Owner routes.** [System Boundaries and Authority](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/system-boundaries-and-authority.html), [Failure Modes of Ungoverned Intelligence](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/failure-modes-of-ungoverned-intelligence.html), [Dangerous Capability Domains and Misuse Uplift](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/dangerous-capability-domains-and-misuse-uplift.html), [Military AI, Autonomous Weapons, and Strategic Stability](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/military-ai-autonomous-weapons-and-strategic-stability.html).

**Core support states.** argument.

**Implemented bounded proof targets.** 11.

**Current boundary.** Editorial synthesis does not transfer support among owners and does not establish system-level efficiency, safety, deployment readiness, AGI, or ASI.

**What would change the conclusion.** Simpler permission systems that resist revocation, bypass, confused-deputy, escalation, and residual-loss failures equally well would justify a smaller boundary model.

**Technical evidence.** Follow the owner routes above and the live book's claim/evidence registry.
:::
